title: MediaUploadOperationResponse
description: Read-only committed metadata for one authenticated owner's exact session and operation UUID. Empty assets is not proof of non-application: an earlier upload may still commit. Session owner_type, claimed_stream_id and expires_at distinguish claimed/expired state. No automatic new upload or slot creation is authorized by this response.

operation_id.description: Optional client-generated UUID bound to this upload session and usage. Replays return the same committed asset while that draft remains valid. A deleted nonce is never reused to create a replacement.
